nom: The Crème Shop Hello Kitty and Friends Soothing Centella Smooth Toner Pads

avis.texte: The pads come sealed up and include tweezer like tool to help pick out the toner pads. I personally really enjoy it and helps keep the rest of the pads sanitary. The toner pads have helped keep my skin clear and feel less irritated. The formula is gentle.

Thank you to the brand for this free product. I have enjoyed using this nightly - the packaging is adorable, there's a little tweezer set included to pick up the pre-moistend flower cut pads. I've been using them after washing my face, and they've been good at swiping away any makeup that still remained. That said, I'm not sure I've seen any visible impact from using these consistently. They just kinda act as an extra clean swipe. They aren't irritating or bad, but they also aren't anything revolutionary. I'll continue to use them until I run out, but I don't think I'd repurchase.

They are honestly the cutest addition to my skincare routine. The packaging alone makes me happy every time I reach for it, but the pads themselves are actually so soothing. They're super soft, fully soaked, and the centella feels calming the moment it touches my skin. I love using them after cleansing — they take down any redness and leave my face feeling fresh, hydrated, and prepped for the rest of my routine. They're gentle enough for everyday use and don't irritate my skin at all. If you love calming skincare and cute packaging, these are such a fun and refreshing step in a nighttime or morning routine.

These are soooo cute and actually work 😭🐱 The pads are super soft and feel really refreshing on my skin. They calm redness fast and leave my face feeling clean, smooth, and hydrated without any sticky feeling. Plus the packaging is a 10/10. If you want a gentle, soothing toner pad, these are a yes 🫶✨

I've loved adding toner pads into my routine. I like that this one comes with tweezers to pull out the pads without having to reach your fingers into the container, and the flower shape is so cute. I really like using toner pads as mini face masks, and I think this one is really gentle and soothing for my skin.

I'm really enjoying these toner pads! I have pretty bad redness on my face, and my skin is definitely sensitive, but I've had nothing but positive experiences so far! They definitely are soothing, and I would say they are hydrating, and the toner also layers well under makeup

This toner has been one of the best I've used in a long time! The packaging and design makes it super user friendly and I absolutely love that it come with tweezers. It doesn't have a scent which I find perfect! My face has had less blemishes and more moisturized since I've started using this. I will 100% purchase again!
I use this in the morning before moisturizer and it really locks it in. Great for face prep before makeup. I have acne prone skin and this did not make me break out at all.

(i received this product free in exchange for my review) these toner pads are great at clearing your skin without drying it out. love that it comes with tongs to pick up the pads! skin feels so soft after using.

i've been using these toner pads during my nighttime routine for the past week now, and they're such a great addition to my routine! with the weather changing, i noticed my skin has been getting dry, so i've been using the toner pads as mini face masks at night to help with my skin barrier! it's sooo refreshing and hydrating and didn't irritate my sensitive skin or make me break out! the packaging and toner pads are also super adorable!!! definitely adds some whimsy to my routine

These Hello Kitty & Friends x The Crème Shop Soothing Centella Toner Pads are super gentle and calming on the skin. The cica complex and ceramide NP help soothe irritation while strengthening the skin barrier, and the pads feel refreshing without being harsh. They're convenient, cruelty-free, and perfect for daily use on my skin, great for anyone looking for a cute, effective way to calm and hydrate their skin.

The Hello Kitty & Friends Soothing Centella Toner Pads are super gentle and calming. They're soaked in a light centella formula that feels refreshing on the skin, and the pads themselves are really soft. They help reduce redness and give just the right amount of hydration without leaving any sticky feeling. Plus, the cute Hello Kitty packaging just makes them fun to use. A great option if you have sensitive skin or just want something soothing in your routine.

I received this product free in exchange for my honest review. I really liked the packaging and overall design, but the product itself did not meet my expectations. The toner pads were less moisturizing than I had hoped, and they seemed to contain less product compared to similar items I've used. I prefer a smoother, more gel-like texture, which I've experienced with other brands' toner pads whereas this one felt more rough. For these reasons, I likely would not purchase this product in the future.

I was skeptical at first since I didn't notice any smell to this product, I assumed it would just be water soaked facial pads, but these are amazing! They've kept my skin from peeling due to dryness in this cold weather and have significantly helped with some of my dark marks from acne/scarring. The product settles into the skin quickly and does not leave any grease or film. The package comes with little Tweezers so there's no need to touch all of the face pads and spread oils off of your fingers. The pack comes with 70 pads for a great price so they're definetely affordable. 10/10 product!!

These toner pads work like a charm! My skin has honestly never looked so plump and hydrated before. With 70 pads, these will last you more than 2 months and are great for skin prep and adding extra moisture to your routine. They even come with a small pair of tweezers to pick the product up with!

These Hello Kitty Toner Pads deliver a gentle sweep of hydration and brightness. Each pad is infused with skin-loving ingredients that help balance your complexion, remove impurities, and leave your skin feeling smooth and refreshed. Ideal for daily use.
I love anything Sanrio! The cute package will make me want to use this more. The toning pads were soothing and gentle. Excited to add these into my skin care routine!
I absolutely love these!! They bring back moisture to my skin and give me an amazing glow

I like to use this for prepping for makeup, and I find that it both calms and gently exfoliates my skin very well. It's really easy to incorporate into a skincare routine too, as a toner or serum. My skin feels smoother with this!

I have sensitive skin, which gets dry and irritated in the winter time and these toner pads have been amazing! they soothe the skin and give it a plump hydration, and most importantly dont irritate my skin!

I got some redness on my cheeks due to irritation. This soothing centella toner pad works wonderfully calming my irritated cheeks. I've been putting it on my cheeks for 10-15 mins everyday in 2 weeks so far. I can see the redness of my cheeks is looking way better how they used to be. It likes a mini sheet mask as a more intensive treatment for targeted areas. Moreover, the packaging is really cute. I'm in love with cute flower shaped toner pads as well. It makes my experience so much fun. Highly recommend it

OMG, just tried the Hello Kitty® and Friends Soothing Centella Toner Pads, and I'm obsessed! 🌸✨ First off, the packaging is super cute like, who doesn't love Hello Kitty? It totally makes my skincare shelf look adorable. The pads themselves are really soft and soaked just right with the toner. When I wiped them across my face, it felt like a gentle hug for my skin. 🌿💖 The Centella Asiatica is a game changer; my skin felt instantly soothed and hydrated, which is perfect for those days when I'm dealing with redness or irritation. I've been using them after cleansing, and I've noticed my skin looking more balanced and refreshed. Plus, they're so easy to use no mess, just grab a pad and go! Overall, if you're looking for a cute and effective way to pamper your skin, definitely give these a try! They're a must-have in my routine now. ✨💅

avis.titre: It's a decent product for now
avis.texte: Another thing I appreciate is how well these fit into my morning and nighttime routine. In the morning they help wake up my complexion and smooth out any overnight dryness. At night, it act as a soothing step after cleansing, especially on days when my skin feels a little stressed or sensitive. the fragrance is light and pleasant. But I would say they are a good pick for anyone who wants a calming toner pad that's effective, convenient, and super adorable packaging but these toner pads deliver more than just cute vibes they actually perform pretty good in my opinion, making them a fun and functional addition to my skincare routine!
this product is perfect for pre-makeup prep! i like to leave the pads on my face for a couple minutes before doing my makeup and it helps keep my skin moisturized!

avis.titre: Love these cute centella toner pads!
avis.texte: I was so excited to try Hello Kitts and Friends Soothing Centella Toner Pads from The Creme Shop! The pads are flower shaped that makes them so fun to use! I used them every morning this week after my shower and they made my skin feel so fresh and hydrated!

I received this product for free in exchange for an honest review I have been using this product for the past few days and can say I love it so far! The pads are super soft and come soaked in a lightweight serum that feels soothing the moment it touches my skin. I love that it gives me that "calm and hydrated" look without feeling greasy or heavy. For context, I have normal skin that can be oily/dry depending on the weather. The Centella really helps with redness, especially on days when my skin feels irritated or sensitive. I love The Creme Shop sheet masks so I had the idea to leave the pads on my cheeks for a couple of minutes as a mini DIY mask, and it makes my skin feel moisturized for the entire day. The serum absorbs quickly and I have noticed that it layers well under makeup. Also, super cute flower shaped cotton pads!!!

This is definitely not a product I would normally gravitate towards, simply because the packaging design (while very cute) reminds me of a product that might be geared towards a younger crowd. However, I am so glad that I got the chance to try these toner pads! The quality of the product is so nice, and the packaging is some of the best of seen for toner pads. To start off, I have been using these for several days now and have had zero issues with dryness or sensitivity, which says a lot for my skin. My skin looks brighter and feels smoother after each use. There is SO much product soaked into the pads that I've actually been cutting them in half! I simply can't use one up all the way, even after swiping it over my entire face and neck. You really get a lot of bang for your buck in this regard. Finally, my absolute favorite thing here is the design of the tub itself. There's a little pair of plastic tweezers inside the lid, so you don't have to put your fingers directly in the tub. This feels way more sanitary than many other similar products I've tried. All in all, I am so impressed by this product and would definitely repurchase.

If you have sensitive or easily irritated skin, the Hello Kitty and Friends Soothing Centella Toner Pads are such a pleasant surprise. They're gentle, calming, and perfect for days when your skin needs a break. The Centella (Cica) infusion really helps reduce redness and gives a noticeable soothing effect without any burning or tingling. The pads themselves are soft, well-soaked, and large enough to cover key areas of your face. They leave the skin feeling refreshed and lightly hydrated—never sticky or oily. I also love that you can use them as a quick swipe after cleansing or leave them on like little sheet masks for extra calming. The packaging is cute (of course—it's Hello Kitty), but it's not just gimmicky. The product actually performs, and the scent is minimal, which is great if you're sensitive to fragrances.

avis.titre: This is definitely my new favorite toner!
avis.texte: *I got this product free to test and review honestly* This is absolutely my new favorite way to apply toner! It more evenly covers your face and overall seems to work better. It also is just way more fun to use as it comes in this cute Hello Kitty container and the pads are shaped like flowers. They come with this tiny little pair of tweezers that allow you to pick out a pad without sticking your fingers all in the container and touching multiple pads at once. This toner seems to brighten my face when used under foundation and if I use it alone it kind of gives me that dewy moisturized look! The price is also very reasonable. It's not scented so just keep that in mind if looking for a scented product but I honestly don't think I would like a scented toner. I really love it and will definitely be back for more!!

I love the cut out of the toner pads, it's shaped like a flower. I apply 2-3 pads and let it sit on my face 10-15 minute for ample moisture. It felt soothing and refreshing and I am able to layer with my moisturizer and sunscreen after!

avis.titre: I would buy this product again and again
avis.texte: "I absolutely love these toner pads from Hello Kitty x The Crème Shop! They are a must-have for sensitive skin. The Centella (Cica) and Ceramides work wonders: they instantly soothe redness and leave my skin super hydrated and soft, with no stickiness. They give a great burst of freshness after cleansing. The packaging is adorable, and the product is cruelty-free. Highly recommend for a calmer skin barrier! ✨💖"

Hello Kitty® and Friends sent me this free sample through the BzzAgent sampling program. These Soothing Centella Toner Pads feel gentle on my skin and leave it refreshed and calm. I love how easy they are to use and how cute the packaging is!

These toner pads are sooo cute, I love how good they do there job. I have acne prone skin so I have to be extra mindful of the products I use. These never break me out and instead has reduced my pores. I use them at night to get all the gunk off my skin and only need one for my entire face!

The Creme Shop kindly sent me this free sample so that I could review it. I really like these toner pads, they're the perfect size to properly tone the whole face. They leave my skin glowy and hydrated, and seem to help calm acne flare-ups rather than creating them. I love the packaging, the included tweezers are such a nice touch and make getting the toner pads so easy.

avis.titre: I would absolutely buy this product again and again.

This product has a super adorable packaging with a pair of clear tweezer like things on the lid which is perfect for taking out a pad from the container. The flower shaped pads are also super adorable itself and this product overall is super hyrdrating. The only issue of this is every time I pick it up, the lid pops open, which is a bit irritating. Other than that, i would use this every single day because this is just super cute and perfect! I would recommend this.
